task: Global AI and AI Agent Intelligence Daily bilingual publish
schedulePolicy: Preserve the existing OpenClaw schedule and timezone; replace only the task workflow.

translationContract.audience: Global AI Agent, infrastructure, technology and business readers
translationContract.style: Native-level technology intelligence publication: professional, concise, accurate and authoritative; never literal word-for-word translation

editorialContract.audience: General global AI, AI Agent, developer, product, infrastructure, technology and business readers
editorialContract.goal: Select news that is fun, useful, meaningful and evidence-backed instead of forcing every item into an ALUX narrative
coverage: notable AI features and model or platform updates
GitHub open source, Skills, MCP and small experiments

selectionMix.signalCount: 6-9, normally 7-9; six only when no seventh candidate passes freshness, source and reader-value gates

majorVendorOpenSourcePolicy.rule: Every must-review release receives an explicit internal disposition; every verified substantive major-vendor model, weight, code, dataset or framework release is selected unless it was already covered within 30 days and has no new evidence.
majorVendorOpenSourcePolicy.licenseLanguage: Distinguish OSI open source, source-available code, open weights and custom community licenses. Downloadable weights alone must not be described as OSI open source.

persistentWatchPolicy.rule: Check official sources every day for tracked announced releases. Do not repeat unchanged announcements; select an item immediately when official weights, code, modules or local runnable artifacts become available.
persistentWatchPolicy.initialWatch: MiniMax H3-Regenerate-2K: distinguish the existing 2K API workflow from the still-pending local open release.

githubMetricsPolicy.scope: Selected open-source and skill-tool items backed by GitHub repositories
githubMetricsPolicy.display: Show an exact same-day GitHub Stars snapshot and license status in both locales, plus one note that Stars measure attention at publication time rather than quality.

officialSurfaces: Authenticated OpenAI or confirmed Codex-team social posts
codexResetWatchPolicy.rule: Monitor actual reset and reset-card issuance events across all official surfaces every day. A help-page definition, documentation change, personal screenshot, community discussion, rumor or unsourced social post is not an event. Keep no-change reviews private. Publish only an event explicitly announced by OpenAI/Codex, a confirmed Codex-team member or OpenAI Support, and require a matching internal codexResetEventId plus event type, eligible plans or workspaces, reset scope, eligibility conditions, official source and effective time.
codexResetWatchPolicy.noEventRule: When no confirmed event exists, the public issue must contain no Codex reset story, placeholder, mechanism explainer or definition update.
codexResetWatchPolicy.timeRule: Convert an official exact effective time to Asia/Shanghai. If no official exact effective time exists, state that no exact Beijing time was announced and never substitute the announcement timestamp.
codexResetWatchPolicy.privacyRule: Account-specific Usage-page evidence, reset balances, screenshots and identity details remain private and cannot be generalized into a public event.

freshnessPolicy.rule: Every selected signal has parseable publishedAt and same-day observedAt. Items older than 14 days require a verifiable newChange and must not be presented as newly published today.

forbiddenVisibleEditorialNarration: why it is on today's list
editorialContract.riscPolicy: Keep the fixed RISC machine primer before the news; do not label or score individual news items
editorialContract.financingPolicy: No dedicated financing window; include financing only when it materially explains a technology, market or industry shift
editorialContract.historicalPolicy: Do not rewrite issues published before the effective date

layoutContract.visualBaseline: Copy the pinned 2026-08-26 editorial-v3.1 CSS and DOM structure exactly; replace current content only

editorialRhythm.guideRole: A factual map of the issue with counts, named examples and one watchpoint per row
editorialRhythm.radarRole: Three concise cross-signal syntheses; each card must connect at least two selected signals

layoutContract.signalCard: Single article flow followed by a compact two-row utility footer; no equal-height side-by-side columns

localeTypography.zh: Write complete Chinese semantic phrases and natural pauses; avoid comma chains and isolated final-line Chinese characters or punctuation.
localeTypography.en: Rewrite for native en-US syntax, clear subject-verb structure and complete title phrases; avoid orphan final-line words and dangling articles, prepositions or conjunctions.
localeTypography.manualBreaks: Do not use br tags, non-breaking spaces or invisible characters to force a line break at one viewport.

steps: Pull the latest main branch and inspect git status.
Read templates/report-master.json, verify its hashes, and use its pinned 2026-08-26 compact-v1 source instead of the latest previous issue as the visual master.
Resume any unfinished translation or review before starting a new date.

Run the private major-vendor open-source scan across the official GitHub and Hugging Face watchlist, review every must-review candidate and reserve a slot for every qualified substantive release before ordinary version updates.
Review every persistent watch against official sources; keep unchanged announcements internal and select confirmed open-release changes immediately.

Monitor when Codex automatic or global usage resets actually occur and when banked reset cards are actually issued across official OpenAI/Codex surfaces and confirmed team social posts; keep no-change and account-specific evidence private, and publish only confirmed events with a matching event ID, eligibility, scope and Beijing time when applicable.
Refresh GitHub Stars and license status for every selected GitHub open-source or Skill item, then keep the same snapshot in Chinese and English.

Generate the Chinese report in the current reviewed layout and the public-interest editorial contract; retain the RISC machine primer but remove per-news RISC scoring and the dedicated financing window.

Create a refined en-US translation for global AI Agent, infrastructure, technology and business readers; complete analysis, initial translation, independent review in a separate editor context, and polish, and never translate literally word for word.
Run the locale copy gate and inspect 1440 desktop, 768 tablet and 390 mobile renders for language-specific semantic wrapping and the contracted grid reflow.
Mark the translation reviewed and refresh source/translation hashes.
Build both locales and update both homepages, latest routes, dated routes, archives and sitemap together.
Run structural, hash, link, SEO and multi-viewport rendering checks.
Run the public release boundary scanner and reject private identity, credentials, local paths, internal artifacts and process narration.
Reject every daily change outside the official release allowlist.
Commit Chinese source, English source, translation manifest and public output together; push the official main branch directly without a pull request or manual merge.
Verify the new official domain and deployed file hashes after Vercel finishes deployment, then verify every legacy route uses exactly one permanent redirect to the matching new route.
Only after official-domain verification, send the fixed multiline Telegram link notification without an attachment.

atomicReleaseFields: homepage last-updated time derived from the newest reviewedAt
hardGates: No locale may be missing for a published date.
Every translation must be reviewed and match the manifest hashes.
Every translation must receive an independent editorial review outside the initial translation pass before it is marked reviewed.
Every English issue must satisfy the translationContract in full; no stage may be skipped or downgraded to literal or browser machine translation.
Chinese and English external source URL sets and structural counts must match.
No unhandled Chinese text may remain in English content.
No horizontal overflow or clipped content at the required viewport matrix.

Every visible label, badge, heading, URL and control stays inside its owning grid or flex cell and does not intersect a non-ancestor sibling; validation uses rendered text ranges rather than element boxes alone.
English heat-row labels use at least a 172px column above 620px, stack at 620px and below, and never cross into or overlap the content column.
English panel headings and their context labels never overlap, and stack at 920px and below.
The visible logo control and language switch are vertically aligned at 44px high, with language targets at least 44px high.
The rendered heat-row overlap gate must pass and must not be bypassed or weakened.
No file outside repositoryPublishAllowlist may enter a daily release commit.
No private identity, credential, local path, internal artifact, work log, tool output or process narration may enter public release content.
No visible editorial self-talk such as selection boundaries, why an item was selected, padding policy or empty-category explanations may appear in a published issue.
The issue must satisfy editorialContract.selectionMix and the compact-v1 news-card layout.

Every issue from 2026-08-26 onward must byte-match the CSS in the pinned 2026-08-26-editorial-v3.1 master and preserve its required DOM structure; the latest previous issue is not a substitute master.

Every issue must use 6-9 signals; normally use 7-9 and allow six only when no seventh candidate passes freshness, source and reader-value gates. Keep release-like items at or below 50%, keep hero statistics semantically distinct, keep the hero lead and judgment concise, and separate the factual role of 今日AI导航 from the cross-signal synthesis role of AI Agent雷达.

Every issue from 2026-08-25 onward must complete the major-vendor GitHub and Hugging Face scan, record an explicit disposition for every must-review candidate, and include every qualified substantive release in selectedSignals.
Every issue from 2026-08-25 onward must complete every persistent watch review, suppress unchanged announcements and select confirmed official open-release changes.
Every selected GitHub open-source or Skill item must show a same-day Stars snapshot and license status in both locales; Stars must be labeled as attention rather than quality.
Every selected signal must use parseable publishedAt and same-day observedAt; items older than 14 days require a verifiable newChange.
Each AI Agent radar title must state a concrete subject and change, stay within 20 Chinese visual units, and render with natural semantic line breaks at desktop and mobile widths.

Every issue from 2026-08-26 onward must complete the official Codex reset event review, distinguish automatic or global resets from banked reset cards, reject help-page explanations, personal screenshots, rumors and unsourced social posts as events, and keep account-specific evidence private.

A public Codex reset signal must match a confirmed internal codexResetEventId backed by OpenAI/Codex, a confirmed Codex-team member or OpenAI Support; when no confirmed event exists, the public issue must say nothing about Codex resets.
Every confirmed public Codex reset event must state eligibility and scope and show an accurately converted Beijing effective time, or explicitly state that no exact Beijing time was announced.
Every issue from 2026-08-26 onward must pass the locale copy gate: Chinese and English use their own natural syntax, and headings or paragraphs contain no manual viewport-specific line breaks.

At the 1440 desktop, 768 tablet and 390 mobile representative viewports, statistics, radar, RISC and utility grids must match the contracted column counts and all visible headings must wrap semantically.
Daily publication must commit and push the official main branch directly; it must not stop at a pull request or wait for a manual merge.
Telegram notification is blocked until the new official domain serves byte-equivalent current home, latest and dated pages and every legacy route passes the single-308 compatibility gate.
Routine Telegram delivery is text-only and must not include HTML, ZIP, image or other report attachments; the fixed official domain is the durable storage and bilingual reading surface.
All canonical, hreflang, sitemap, QR-code, share-card and newly published public links must use https://ai.alux.network/daily/ rather than the compatibility domain.
The compatibility domain home, English, latest and dated routes must use exactly one 308 redirect to the matching new route, preserve query parameters, and never produce /daily/daily/.
Routine daily publication must not modify DNS; only the public routing contract belongs in this repository, while provider account and verification data must remain private.
Do not push when any validation fails.
